scope: Repository Kconfig interactive numbered terminal menu and file lifecycle migrated to Node.js 26
features: Explicit overwrite/discard prompts; EOF does not save
Backup, symlinks, atomic output, optimistic external-change checks
Edits made during save remain dirty

steps: Node make menuconfig sets low-level options and SERIAL_BAUD=115200

journey.scope: New process, parse, line-menu redraws, 15 edits, full save, minimal export, exit; piped input/output, warm compile/filesystem cache

save.scope: Edit, recompute, conflict checks, backup, atomic replacement and saved-state update; warm filesystem cache

benchmark.limitation: No curses comparison or target board/printing timing claim; real PTY correctness is validated separately

limitations: Numbered line menu replaces curses key bindings, not a visual clone
External-change checks are optimistic, not OS-level compare-and-swap against arbitrary writers
An interrupted save can leave a lock; no automatic stale-lock deletion
No comparison to old curses responsiveness or target-board timing
Default Python printing runtime and other modules remain; hardware and existing crash/precision diagnostics not closed
